rationale: Standard and Fast share bounded fixed FP64 anchor implementation and explicit selection. Preserve the existing unset default only for scientifically eligible budget-Fock, budget-stationarity WB97M-V restricted exact-Direct cold VV10 owners at 192 or more AOs, without a fixed upper ceiling. Strict Standard and smaller eligible owners remain opt-in; explicit 0 disables both and explicit 1 cannot bypass model, precision, lifetime or resource admission. Missing qualification of a common default does not establish a defect in the existing Fast policy. Historical receipts retain their source and workload limits; this retention is not new numerical or performance qualification and does not resolve HF, DF or moved/fresh force failures. Five FP64 matrices and one scalar remain charged and bounded, with final physical closure and force-pressure retirement unchanged.
revisit_condition: Change the existing default only with evidence addressing its admitted endpoint domain or an explicit accepted policy tradeoff. A common automatic policy still requires matched Standard/Fast complete cold/warm/moved observables, independent oracles, semantic work and resource bounds. Preserve explicit rollback and all numerical gates.
